explanation: This template filter is vulnerable to Cross-Site Scripting (CWE-79) because it marks raw serialized JSON with mark_safe(), disabling Django auto-escaping. When rendered inside HTML or inline script tags, untrusted values containing HTML or script-closing sequences can execute arbitrary JavaScript in victims' browsers. The repair translates characters using _safe_js_escapes before mark_safe(), though completeness cannot be verified because _safe_js_escapes is not defined in this snippet.
